brief:
Israeli settlers set fire to two vehicles during attacks on the Palestinian villages of Turmus Ayya and Abu Falah, east of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. The incidents were documented in videos posted by residents of the attacked communities.

The settlers targeted the outskirts of both villages in what marked renewed violence in the area. Palestinian residents filmed evidence of the vehicle fires during the assaults.

title: Settlers torch vehicles in two West Bank villages
